# Known Devin / OpenCode base model ids that must resolve to pricing
# (or be listed in DEVIN_UNPRICED_MODEL_IDS) once real rates are published.
#
# Pricing is currently stubbed (`DEVIN_MODEL_COSTS` is empty), so this fixture
# stays empty on purpose. When populating `src/pricing-data.ts`, add each
# covered base id here (one per line) and re-run `bun run check:pricing`.
#
# Example:
# claude-opus-5
# swe-1-7
